pythonFunction.name: classify_turn_intent
pythonFunction.description: Intent-first Pass A: classify the user's latest message into exactly one intent. intent = 'continue' (answering/confirming the current request — the default), 'switch:<flow>' (replace current with a different service), 'new_request:<flow>' (an additional/separate request), 'resume:<flow>' (go back to a paused request), 'correct:<slot>' (change an already-given detail), 'cancel', or 'escalate' (reach a human). Output ONLY this tool call, no text. The system maps it to the real action.
